info.title: Multi-Agent Knowledge Assistant
info.description: Multi-tenant document intelligence: upload documents or URLs, ask questions, get cited answers.

post.description: Create a new tenant with its first admin. Disabled in production (use `python -m app.cli create-tenant`).

Multi-file upload. Default: synchronous (validated, extracted, embedded and indexed before the response).
With ?async=true: files are queued for background workers and 202 + job ids are returned.

get.description: Structured tables extracted from the source (spreadsheets, DOCX, HTML, PDF), each with its location.

schema.title: Response Messages Conversations  Conv Id  Messages Get

post.description: Server-Sent Events: `step` (real graph progress), `token` (answer text pieces), `final` (full response incl. citations), `error`.

get.description: Checkpoint trail of the agent graph for this conversation (route, per-node trace, verification) - newest first.
Knowledge graph view: top entities; neighbours of `entity`; or the shortest connection between `entity` and `to`.

post.description: Speech-to-text for voice queries (OpenAI Whisper). Browsers can alternatively use client-side speech recognition.
Runs synchronously (a few seconds for the sample; up to 500 questions otherwise). Results are stored per tenant.

get.description: Effective configuration; secrets are masked and never returned.

delete.description: Irreversibly erase every document, vector, conversation, job and evaluation of the caller's tenant (users are kept).
Delete ALL sources of the current workspace (X-Session-ID) and its conversation memory.

source_ids.title: Source Ids
source_ids.description: Restrict to these sources (default: all in the session)

conversation_id.title: Conversation Id
conversation_id.description: Continue this conversation (default: the user's latest one in the workspace)

retrieval.description: Per-request RAG strategy overrides (mode, rewrite, multi_query, hyde, rerank, filters, ...)

sample.title: Sample
sample.description: Evaluate the built-in synthetic corpus in a throw-away workspace instead of your own documents

dataset.description: Your questions + gold passages (required unless sample=true); evaluated against the current workspace

kinds.title: Kinds
kinds.description: pdf, csv, xlsx, docx, txt, md, json, url, image

contains.title: Contains
contains.description: case-insensitive phrase that must occur in the retrieved chunk

RelevantRef.title: RelevantRef
RelevantRef.description: A gold passage: the source file and (optionally) page / sheet / row and a phrase the passage must contain.

RetrievalOptions.title: RetrievalOptions
RetrievalOptions.description: Per-request overrides; anything left unset falls back to the server defaults (MKA_*).
